purpose: Post-hoc selected-case detector-weighted diagnostic after the q≈5 late-window residual was known. The mass sweep tests whether the short unweighted overlap hides a larger inspiral discrepancy. It is not an independent physical holdout or release gate.
lower_cutoff: max(10 Hz, 2*NR catalog reference orbital M Omega/(2*pi*M_seconds)); reference time equals the highest-resolution metadata relaxation time
psd: Pinned public lalsimulation SimNoisePSDaLIGOZeroDetHighPower; validation-only dependency
time_taper: At both common time-support boundaries multiply by 0.5*(1+tanh((t-t0-w/2)/(w/10))) and its time-reversed end factor, with w=50 M.
analytic_mode_convention: FFT of conjugated h_22 complex mode; compare positive-frequency bins, optimize one global time and phase shift, no amplitude or intrinsic-parameter fit.
published_reference: Bohé et al. 2017, arXiv:1611.03703v3, Sec. IV.A, Eqs. (18)-(19): design zero-detuned high-power PSD, NR settled-frequency or 10 Hz lower bound, 3 kHz upper bound, time/phase optimization; 99% mass-domain criterion and separate 5 M peak-time criterion.
limitations: Sparse masses and one post-hoc case; complex dominant-mode proxy, finite taper/FFT controls, no independently checked physical peak-time criterion, no whole parameter domain or independent ROM.
